name: 1Day Sooner
summary: A US nonprofit, founded in 2020 to represent volunteers for COVID-19 challenge studies, that now campaigns for faster vaccines and pandemic preparedness: hepatitis C challenge studies, plans for challenge studies in a future pandemic, an FDA preparedness programme, indoor air cleaning such as far-UV, and faster rollout of malaria vaccines in Africa.

spending.source: https://apps.irs.gov/pub/epostcard/990/xml/2025/2025_TEOS_XML_11B.zip (Form 990 for 2024, IRS e-file object 202533209349300073, Part IX line 25 (B): programme services $2,262,397 of total expenses $2,424,138, calendar year 2024; statements not audited)

lines.label: Challenge-study advocacy and volunteer representation, Warp Speed 2.0, hepatitis C challenge studies, pandemic challenge studies, indoor air quality and malaria vaccine deployment (every programme)
lines.source: https://apps.irs.gov/pub/epostcard/990/xml/2025/2025_TEOS_XML_11B.zip (Form 990 for 2024, Part III line 4a, the only programme line: advocacy for trial participants, policy campaigns for regulatory innovation and support for vaccine research, $2,262,397). One line because charityevals models the five programme areas of its 2025-2026 funding proposal as branches of one catastrophic-risk model.
